definitions.gloss: proof; evidence; token (of love, effort, etc.)
definitions.explanation: Something that shows a feeling, fact or quality to be real, especially an intangible one such as love, friendship or effort.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{指輪|ゆびわ}→指輪：01744_yubiwa⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{友情|ゆうじょう}→友情：03648_yuujou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{証|あかし}だ。
examples.english: This ring is a token of our friendship.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大会|たいかい}→大会：03386_taikai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{金|きん}メダル→金メダル：20781_kinmedaru⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦{練習|れんしゅう}→練習：05323_renshuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{続|つづ}けてきた{証|あかし}だ。
examples.english: Her gold medal at the competition is proof of the practice she has kept up every day.

notes:
USAGE:
An emotional, somewhat literary word, used mostly for intangible things: love, trust, effort, a life lived (⟦{生|い}きた→生きる：01184_ikiru⟧{証|あかし}). For evidence in a legal or factual sense, use ⟦{証拠|しょうこ}→証拠：10575_shouko⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{愛|あい}→愛：02370_ai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{証|あかし}: a token of love
- ⟦{生|い}きた→生きる：01184_ikiru⟧{証|あかし}: proof that one lived, a mark left on the world
- ⟦{身|み}→身：01764_mi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{証|あかし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{立|た}てる→立てる：01196_tateru⟧: to prove one's innocence

WRITING:
Also written {証|あか}し. The kanji {証|しょう} is read しょう in compounds such as ⟦{証拠|しょうこ}→証拠：10575_shouko⟧ and ⟦{証明|しょうめい}→証明：03242_shoumei⟧.
